reason: Empirical artifact-and-case-study paper (SandboxEval: 51 hand-crafted safety test cases run inside a real Dyff/gVisor sandbox) on safely executing untrusted LLM-generated code; it also measures that only ~16.47% of LLM-generated test cases were syntactically valid, a documented failure mode of LLM-authored tests directly relevant to the testing-strategy goal.
